resources.query: AppMetrics | where Name=='_APPRESOURCEPREVIEW_' | where TimeGenerated>ago(3h) | extend r=tostring(Properties['azure.containerapps.revision.name']) | where r=='ca-mh-user001-dotnet--release-47acf263d332' | project Properties

traces.query: union (AppRequests|extend sig='http.server'), (AppDependencies|extend sig=iff(DependencyType=='SQL','db.client',Name)), (AppExceptions|extend sig='exception') | where AppRoleInstance startswith 'ca-mh-user001-dotnet--release-47acf263d332' | where TimeGenerated>ago(3h) | summarize count() by sig

metrics.query: AppMetrics | where AppRoleInstance startswith 'ca-mh-user001-dotnet--release-47acf263d332' | where TimeGenerated>ago(3h) | where Name in ('http.server.request.duration','db.client.operation.duration','catalog.import.records','catalog.query.duration','catalog.performance.duration') | project Name,Sum,ItemCount,Properties

logs.query: union (AppTraces|extend sig=tostring(Properties['OriginalFormat'])|extend sig=iff(isempty(sig),Message,sig)), (AppExceptions|extend sig=tostring(Properties['OriginalFormat'])) | where AppRoleInstance startswith 'ca-mh-user001-dotnet--release-47acf263d332' | where TimeGenerated>ago(3h) | summarize count() by sig
